_doc: AI autonomous PAPER book policy. Read live by auto/autotrader.py (entries) and risk.py BOOK=auto (risk_overrides). Tuned by auto/tuner.py (rule-based, bounded). See docs/AUTO_BOOK.md.

pre_verdict._doc: Size for an entry made on the early script verdict before an AI verdict exists. Kept small. An AI discard never opens a position; on_ai_discard says what happens to a pre_verdict position when the AI verdict later comes back discard.

_on_ai_discard_doc: exit: sell the pre_verdict position when the AI verdict is discard. keep: hold it and record AI disagreed on the trade.

entry_filters._doc: Impersonation block (auto/impersonation.json, fuzzy) unless exact-CA X buzz; Watch/Scout need >=1 non-shill author posting the exact CA; no pools <10 min or live liq <$10k; weight to winner profile (sustained non-dust volume, steady multi-minute climb).
